raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pixsfm
  version: "1.0.0"
  build_number: 29
  # Prioritize gpu build if cudatoolkit can be installed (through __cuda virtual package)
  processor: ${{ "gpu" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu" }}
  build: ${{ build_number + 100 if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else build_number }}

package:
  name: pixsfm
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/cvg/pixel-perfect-sfm/archive/refs/tags/v${{ (version | split('.'))[0] }}.${{ (version | split('.'))[1] }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 0b24a8b90ec1aeac4f8e2df211f1604d585c7f3a71be4626bb6750b020b5ad1b
  patches:
    - unvendor.patch
    - limit-parallel-jobs.patch
    - if: osx
      then: fix-osx.patch
    - 119.patch
    - fix-python-executable.patch
    - fix-pyceres.patch
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: find-cudatoolkit.patch
    - fix-python-314.patch
    - fix-eigen5.patch
    # don't link libpython into the extension module (avoids overlinking now that libpython is split out)
    - if: linux
      then: no-embed.patch
    # port to COLMAP 4.x / pycolmap 4.x (and hloc with pycolmap >= 3.13)
    - colmap4.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build }}
  string: ${{ processor }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build }}
  skip: win
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv
  dynamic_linking:
    overlinking_behavior: error

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - cmake <4
    - make
    - git
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp
    - if: linux
      then: libgomp
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - numpy
        - pybind11
  host:
    - hdf5
    - pybind11 3.0.1.*
    - highfive <3
    - cpp-half
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools <82
    - eigen
    - eigen-abi-devel
    - cgal-cpp
    - ceres-solver
    - numpy
    - pyceres
    - pytorch
    - torchvision
    - libboost-devel
    - glog
    - gflags
    # linked directly via COLMAP's (static) link interface
    - libcurl
    - libopenimageio
    - openssl
    - if: linux
      then: libgl-devel
    # colmap4.patch requires the COLMAP 4 API; without a lower bound the solver
    # may silently fall back to colmap 3.8
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - colmap >=4.2 cuda*
        - pycolmap * cuda*
        - libcurand-dev
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
      else:
        - colmap >=4.2 cpu*
        - pycolmap * cpu*
        # otherwise the solver prefers the CUDA build of ceres-solver
        - ceres-solver * cpu*
  run:
    - python
    - pycolmap
    - pyceres
    - tqdm
    - matplotlib-base
    - plotly
    - scipy
    - h5py
    - omegaconf
    - packaging
    - hloc
    - setuptools <82
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: __cuda >=${{ cuda_compiler_version }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pixsfm
        - pixsfm.refine_colmap
        - pixsfm.refine_hloc
      pip_check: false
  - files:
      recipe:
        - test_geometric_ba.py
    script:
      - python test_geometric_ba.py
  # compares keypoint/bundle adjustment and query refinement against pixsfm 1.0
  - files:
      source:
        - datasets/sacre_coeur/mapping/
      recipe:
        - test_regression.py
        - regression_data.tar.xz
    script:
      - python test_regression.py

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/cvg/pixel-perfect-sfm
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Pixel-Perfect Structure-from-Motion
  description: |
    Here we provide pixsfm, a Python package that can be readily used with COLMAP and our toolbox hloc.
    This makes it easy to refine an existing COLMAP model or reconstruct a new dataset with state-of-the-art
    image matching. Our framework also improves visual localization in challenging conditions.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Tobias-Fischer
